scope: read-only source inventory refreshed 2026-10-05 after catalogue-v4. It records the bounded library test receipt for full_engine and C streaming, but neither an ordinary-CLI integration nor a portfolio/benchmark result.
native_root: rust/cix-native/src/full_engine plus paq bridge/supervisor and generic engine
observed_dispatch_fact: The current native tree has a compiled full_engine::catalogue and FullEngine archive dispatch/provider surface. catalogue-v4 tested that library surface. The ordinary CLI/generic portfolio selector still contains no call into full_engine catalogue/dispatch, so specialist routes remain unavailable to normal automatic CLI operation.

status_meanings.library_only: reversible native functions exist, but no current generic/full-engine selector or top-level archive dispatcher calls them

status_meanings.declared_but_unlinked: the type/frame surface names the route but source explicitly returns an unlinked-transform error
status_meanings.absent: no equivalent native implementation was found in the inspected source
status_meanings.library_tested_unwired: compiled native library route with narrow recorded source-bound focused tests, but no ordinary CLI automatic selector/encoder integration; it is not a release qualification

highest_priority_missing_edges: Wire FullEngine catalogue admission, explicit candidate evaluation/tie policy, resource accounting and archive dispatch into the ordinary CLI/portfolio path; preserve generic whole-file alternatives and no silent fallback.
Implement automatic CIXH1 mixed encoding: regions and carrier exist, but no automatic region-to-candidate policy, paid comparison, or CLI surface selects it.

Port/register exact historical grid_context CIXB\x1f and grid_conditional CIXB\x20 frames. Retain CIXY\x01 feedback and CIXZ\x01 interval outer decoders separately from the new CIXB\x1e bounded route.
Add native JPEG-LS and JPEG-2000 provider support only with pinned build/dispatch/limit contracts, so CIXI\x01 modes 3 and 2 can decode; current JXL support covers mode 1 only.
Port call-entry and relocated-pointer executable routes if retained, with their exact frame identities, inverses, fixtures and catalogue entries.
Account for the historical LSTM/prediction route: no native implementation or frame decoder was found. Its recorded -12L comparison remains resource-excluded under the stated 12 GB bound.
acceptance_per_route: For each retained route: source-to-archive parity fixture where applicable; fresh native encode; separate archive-only native decode; malformed/limit tests; resource accounting; no Python process or PATH lookup; and candidate/decoder registration evidence.
